class.name: HEGoTerrain3DInstancer
class.brief_description: Scatters scenes onto an existing Terrain3D through its instancer.
class.description: The point fetch groups points by terrain node path and then by scene path, so one HDA can populate several terrains with several scenes each. Slots HEGo generated on a previous cook are recognised by their [code]hegot3d_[/code] name prefix and reused, which keeps hand-authored mesh assets untouched.

method.name: point_attribs
method.description: Attributes this handler reads off each instanced point: the shared orientation set plus colour. A function rather than a const, because a const cannot be built from another class's constant. See [HEGoPointUtil].

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Whether the cook produced points flagged for Terrain3D instancing.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the cook's instancing points and populates the terrains.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Points with this attribute set to 1 are scattered onto a terrain.
Attributes naming the terrain to scatter onto and the scene to scatter.
Name prefix of the mesh asset slots HEGo owns.
Terrain3DMeshAsset properties an HDA can drive, keyed by point attribute name.
